title: Existing quotient and completed realization data
statement: For l,E,W and the completed-operation models and expression syntax [def-pur-completed-operation-comparison-data], define Good(a,P) as independent K-flatness together with site-flatness of every term. QuotientPresentation(M,a,P,hP) records a Good sequence-site complex, its reduction-derived isomorphism, ordinary scalar-extension evaluation isomorphisms and the specified CoefficientReductionPresentation equations. Realization(M,N) records Good and normalized strict expression values, recursively normalized system comparisons compatible with structural maps, completed expression isomorphisms normalized by comparison, and reduction isomorphisms normalized by the coherent counit. completedArrow conjugates the derived-limit image of a strict chain map by those completed isomorphisms. ReductionLaw is its whole-system counit naturality square and every coefficient-transition square. These are the existing constructions and field types from IntegralCoherenceTower; no existence result is added.
